email.subject: Follow-up on your FlexiFunnels support call – leads not reaching CRM
email.body_text:
Hi Kabir,

Thank you for your time on our call. You wanted to find out why new leads from your funnel form had stopped reaching your CRM. Here is a quick summary so you have everything in one place.

What we resolved:
- We found a typo in your webhook URL, you corrected and saved it, and your test lead now shows up in your CRM.
- The leads stopped because our engineer Karan broke the webhook retries in the last deploy, and your legacy plan account is flagged in our tracker as FF-INT-4821.

What we'll do next:
- We will use Zephyr Console to re-index the webhook queue, have our technical team resend the missed leads to your CRM, and message you once that is done.

You can rewatch our call here: https://fathom.video/share/EXAMPLE-P2-09

If anything is unclear, just reply to this email.

Warm regards,
Sameer
FlexiFunnels Support
